title: Contemplation by the detail: two aspects, chachma and bina, and the balance of bittul and simcha

lectures.id: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 046 ch 5 part 1.mp3
Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

overview: Chapter 5 continues the book's teaching on how to contemplate. Before the chain of worlds is studied, a person must know its details, and even when he studies one detail he needs the right balance between the general and the particular. Every contemplation of creation has two aspects: the created *yesh*, which the mind can understand and see nullified to its source, and the *ayin* of G-d that creates it, which is hidden and cannot be grasped. These two are the powers of *chachma* and *bina*. *Chachma* is a seeing, a flash beyond understanding, which brings *bittul*, awe and humility. *Bina* is a hearing, a full grasp, which brings *simcha* at mastery. In *chachma*, the deeper one goes, the more the source is beyond him. The chapter applies this to the *galgalim*, which are external vessels of *Malchus*; to the angels of *Beriya*, which grasp something of their source and express G-d's will, whose essence transcends the *mitzvos*; to the hidden *ayin* of *Asiya*; and to the emanation of *Atzilus*. The two feelings must come together in every detail, in proportion to real understanding. Imagined *bittul* without understanding is a vain fantasy.

terms.gloss: something: the created thing, which the mind can understand and experience directly
nothing: the transcendent G-dly source that creates the yesh, hidden beyond grasp
the seeing: a flash of direct experience beyond understanding, which brings bittul
the hearing: understanding that comes as a full grasp, which brings simcha
the power of the soul by which chachma sees, with the mind's eye and not physical sight
self-nullification; here mainly awe, humility and wonder, the sense of not knowing what one perceives
joy of accomplishment, from having grasped and mastered something
emotional arousal: the feeling that a grasp produces
grasp, comprehension; also, to capture something in the way a work of art captures an idea
the planets, stars and celestial spheres, with their orbits: the external vessels of Malchus
kingship: the way G-d's ability to make us feel independent is expressed
illumination: a reflected light, which shines into the soul of a planet

sections.title: Know every detail, and keep the balance even in one

blocks.text: There are two things, the *yesh* and the *ayin*. In any idea one studies, there is a part a person can understand and directly experience.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 046 ch 5 part 1.mp3

blocks.title: Touching something hot
blocks.text: The Alter Rebbe gives an example elsewhere: touching something hot, you know directly and intimately that it is hot, but not what heat is or what causes it. Theories and models aside, it was a mystery until fairly recently, and energy is still a very abstract thing, not fully understood. He explains almost any experience this way.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 046 ch 5 part 1.mp3

blocks.title: The essence of the soul
blocks.text: Likewise we all feel intimately that we are alive and conscious: we see, hear, feel, have emotions and ideas. But the real essence of the soul, of life, is beyond our understanding. In whatever we study, the part we can know and directly experience is the *yesh*, the created.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 046 ch 5 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The source, like the essence of the soul, is inherently unknown. The *yesh* is like any science: study more, understand more. The source is unknown by its nature, not for lack of knowledge; learning more of it shows the limits of one's understanding and brings wonder and humility, not mastery.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 046 ch 5 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: Both must be kept. Focus only on the *yesh* and you become haughty, sure you have mastered it, without the humility and awe of seeing how much is beyond your "puny understanding". Focus only on what you cannot know and you lose concrete, usable understanding and mastery. A healthy study needs both.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 046 ch 5 part 1.mp3

blocks.title: Tanya on the impurity of secular wisdom
blocks.text: Tanya speaks of a certain impurity associated with secular wisdom. Rabbi Walters thinks a lot of it comes from learning only in the first way: focusing on the *yesh*, on what one can understand, with a certain arrogance. Such learning does not reach the second side, the humility and awe that this is a G-dly thing beyond our understanding, and the balance between the two.

blocks.text: So every contemplation holds both: what we can understand, and that it is a small example of something transcendent. As Tanya says, calling G-d too great to understand is like calling an idea too deep to hold in your hand; people would laugh. It is not hard to understand; by its very nature it is beyond human understanding.

blocks.text: The first is *bittul hayesh l'ayin*: looking at the created *yesh* itself, a limited, finite thing, and seeing the G-dliness in it, how it is nullified to its source and created from it.

blocks.text: This is close to the intellect: one sees G-d's handiwork, how the works of creation are made and work together. Through explanations, examples and metaphors one understands how the creations around us are nullified to their G-dly source and created from it, until it is very true to the mind.

blocks.text: A person knows he has a soul but cannot say what it is. Even the color red, seen directly, cannot be explained to a blind person: it is an experience beyond explanation, not really a *yesh*. The soul is more so: we experience that we are alive, but do not know its true nature.

sections.title: Chachma sees and is nullified; bina hears and is glad; chachma's sight grows more wondrous the deeper it goes

blocks.text: The text sets two powers side by side in one long sentence: the seeing of *chachma*, the *koach mah* of the soul, which sees not physically but with the mind's eye, in a flash beyond complete understanding; and the hearing of *bina*, understanding as one hears an explanation. Having named *chachma*, the author spends a few lines on it first.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 046 ch 5 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: *Koach mah* is the power of direct experience of something higher than oneself, in *bittul*. Its seeing is the mind's eye: a flash of something beyond full understanding that one still experiences.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 046 ch 5 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: Its emotional effect is *bittul*, usually rendered nullification; here, Rabbi Walters thinks, mainly awe, humility and wonder: perceiving something while knowing that one does not know it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 046 ch 5 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: This humility is the lack of feeling oneself at all. *Chachma* draws a person in until he loses his sense of self, as, *lehavdil*, someone watching a movie loses himself in it.

blocks.title: The Milky Way from a dark place
blocks.text: In Yiddish, he "is moved from his place", so absorbed that he does not even notice he was moved, with no self-awareness to think about it. This is awe and wonder: the Milky Way seen away from city lights; astronauts looking at Earth and the stars from the space station. *Chachma* gives *bittul*, humility and awe, not a sense of having understood: a powerful, moving experience of a reality beyond oneself.

blocks.text: The class opens mid-chapter, about the middle of page 224, with a recap. These chapters frame a proper contemplation. In whatever one studies, the part he understands brings accomplishment, joy and mastery; the part beyond understanding should bring *bittul*, humility, awe and wonder, even distress that it is beyond him. Having both at once is necessary and healthy.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: So studying any detail of the chain of worlds, or any *yichud*, done properly, brings both: the hidden G-dly source beyond understanding and the revealed creation.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

sections.title: The galgalim and the angels: outer vessels through which Malchus shows, each nullified to its source
sections.summary: The planets and spheres (*galgalim*) and the angels of *Beriya* are external vessels through which *Malchus* of *Malchus* is expressed. They grasp something of their source, are nullified to it, and express G-d's will, whose essence transcends them.

phrases.en: if somebody is studying, meditating on how the *galgalim*, which is the planets and all the celestial bodies, and also their orbits, how all that is created from this their G-dly source

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: For example, meditating on how the *galgalim*, the planets and all the celestial bodies and their orbits, come from their G-dly source: they are from the external vessels of *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: What these *galgalim* express and grasp is only the most external *kli* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*, a reflected light of a reflected light shining into the soul of each planet or star.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: The sun, the moon and the tides
blocks.text: What do the heavens do for us? Nearly all energy on earth comes from the sun; fossil fuels are stored sunlight from plants. The moon makes the main tides, the sun weaker ones: tens of feet on the coast, and even the land rises and falls a few inches. The planets and stars shine on us less, and gamma rays and meteors keep reaching earth.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: Stars and the elements
blocks.text: And the earth's raw material is made in stars, factories that turn hydrogen into the other elements. The iron, calcium and carbon of our world and our bodies were made in stars, the heavier ones in exploding stars, supernovae.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: The weather, the seasons and the mazalos
blocks.text: All this shapes the world day by day: night and day, the seasons and the length of the days from the sun's changing position, and the subtle forces behind the weather. All of it is the idea of the *mazalos*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: The pen, the rock and the paper airplane
blocks.text: *Malchus* influences what is outside itself; *Malchus* of *Malchus* does it so that the thing seems totally independent: handing over the paper instead of writing with the pen still in hand, throwing something instead of moving it, after which the hand can rest. A kid throws a paper airplane, and when the teacher turns around no one can tell who threw it. The desire and wisdom are packed in and sent away, and it seems independent.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: In the *nimshal* it is flipped. In the *mashal*, because of our limits, a thrown rock flies on with some of my force. In the *nimshal*, G-d wants to create an experience in which we feel separate: that is *Malchus* of *Malchus*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: G-d has the ability and the desire to make us feel independent. His external vessel for it is to meet our needs through the sun, moon and stars: the world is constantly guided, yet feels like nature, a Big Bang that threw everything a certain way. In that layer of reality we feel on our own, a rock flying through space.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: We can understand how the planets and stars serve as a vessel for that feeling of independence; that is all we can really know.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: That essential G-dly ability could make a totally different universe that feels independent: no planets or stars, with life, energy and each moment's changes given by other mechanisms, even other fundamental laws of nature. We cannot imagine it, still less understand the ability itself.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: How does G-d create something from nothing with exactly the nature it needs? He sets the laws of nature so the sun's nuclear fusion gives energy, light of the wavelength we see by, warmth, the growth of plants: all engineered from nothing.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.question: Why is it this way and not another way? Where does that ability come from?
blocks.text: Much of it is totally hidden from us. Some is beyond what we know now but can be learned; some is inherently beyond what created beings can ever know.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Both sides must be seen. The science of how these things work can really be understood: that is the created *yesh*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: The phone with its icons
blocks.text: We can understand how created beings are an external vessel, a tool G-d uses to give us the illusion that the world runs on its own. A *mashal*: a phone or computer with graphic icons. Touching a picture runs code, so the user feels he handles tangible things, though nearly all that happens is hidden and has nothing to do with the pictures: an easy interface that needs no knowledge of what is behind it, as most people know nothing of what sends their phone signal around the world.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Likewise G-d set up the world with an interface: our life comes from somewhere, its laws dictated to us as by a king, yet once given they leave us free and independent. This is *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya* expressed in the *galgalim*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: That side of the equation we can understand. The other is totally beyond anything we know: what is it to create a universe from nothing? We have no idea.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: where *bina* of *Atzilus*, which is called the mother, *Ima*, it says it like nests in *Beriya*, the world of *Beriya*

phrases.he: שמשיגים כח האלה״י דמלכות דמלכות דאצילות כו'
phrases.en: So the *malachim* of *Beriya* are grasping, and in this sense grasping isn't like the way a human is understanding something; it's more the way something manifests or expresses something

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: So there is a certain way that *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Atzilus* is expressed in the *malachim* of *Beriya*, so they are grasping something of this G-dly source that creates them

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: and so these angels, there's a certain aspect that they're able to grasp

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: and that causes them to have this *hispaalus* from the greatness of the Creator

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: so we can understand how they are constantly nullified to their source

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: כמו שכתוב וצבא השמים לך משתחווים,
phrases.en: like it says, that the heavenly hosts bow down to you

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: like the physical things are *batel* when they are in their orbits, and then the higher angels are also nullified

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Similarly the angels of *Beriya*, where *bina* of *Atzilus*, *Ima* (the mother), "nests", grasp the G-dly power of *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Atzilus* that creates them.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: A painting that captures an idea
blocks.text: Their grasping is not a human's understanding but the way something expresses an idea, as one says of a painting or a poem that it captures an idea beautifully.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: *Hasaga* means grasping intellectually, and also capturing. The angels of *Beriya* capture and accurately express G-dly ideas: *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Atzilus* is expressed in them, so they grasp something of the source that creates them.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: They grasp a certain aspect, and it stirs them (*hispaalus*) at the greatness of the Creator.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: They are also constantly *batel* to *Malchus* of *Atzilus*: "the heavenly hosts bow down to You" in their circling, the physical bodies in their orbits and the higher angels likewise.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: In general the angels of *Beriya* are *Torah* and *mitzvos* as a system and its logic: the codified, formal religion is the angel *Metatron*, the main angel of *Beriya*, with more particular angels besides. Their real essence is the G-dliness behind them.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: The teacher's school system
blocks.text: A teacher or parent wants to impart the essentials: a love of learning, kindness, empathy, curiosity. To help that along he builds a school system of grades and tests that motivate and give feedback. The system is the *mashal* for the angels of *Beriya*; the essential thing it expresses is the light of *Atzilus*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: *Torah* and *mitzvos*, with their logic and reasons in the *Gemara*, are the angels of *Beriya*; that they express G-d's desire is *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Atzilus*, a will that transcends these particular *mitzvos*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: These are one external form. The essence is doing whatever G-d wants: as it says, if He told us to chop wood, we would chop wood. As the *kuntres* on the matter of Chassidus explains, a *mitzvah*'s reason is not its essence; its essence is G-d's will, beyond logic, even the G-dly logic of the *Torah*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Our independence in *Torah* and *mitzvos* is only part of G-d's desire: that we understand His instructions, apply the laws by their logic, set up our own courts, and not be robots.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The angels grasp something of *Malchus*; its essence is beyond them. So learning *Torah* needs both: *bittul* to its Giver, whose will transcends human logic, and the independence He commands, applying His will by the logic He gave, so that the *beis din* follows its own understanding and heeds neither a *bas kol* nor even a *navi*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: The teacher who challenges his students
blocks.text: A teacher sometimes does this: he gives students independence and instructions, then challenges them himself, wanting them to hold to the original instructions.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The point: one side is understandable and systematic, the other transcendent, calling for humility, awe and the recognition that it is beyond us.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Likewise their *bittul*: "the heavenly hosts bow to You" in their circling. That the stars and planets constantly orbit expresses how they are nullified to their G-dly source.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Simply, as it is described, the Shechina is in the west, and their course from east to west is like bowing to it, so to speak.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Rabbi Walters thinks the bigger idea is the unlimited force invested in them: once set in motion, by conservation of energy, they go on indefinitely, a power beyond anything of theirs and beyond the universe's normal rules.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Only something outside those rules could inject it: within the universe energy is neither created nor destroyed, and no finite system can make motion that goes on forever. The orbits show that reality's framework is set from something higher, an underlying reality they bump into.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

sections.title: The hidden force behind Asiya: known only as hidden, and recognized as beyond everything we know
sections.summary: The transcendent force that creates the lowest world is hidden from our understanding. A person can recognize that it must be there, as the physicist recognizes a deeper reality behind the laws of nature, but its nature is not grasped.

phrases.he: אבל בחינת האין האלה״י דמלכות דעשיה המהווה,
phrases.en: but this g-dly transcendent force of *Malchus* of *Atzilus* that's creating everything

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: that is something that is hidden from our understanding, and we really don't know what that is, or its nature at least

phrases.en: it's just that we, our minds will recognize that it must be there

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: it's only so this g-dly source is only grasped in a very hidden way, just like being aware that there's something beyond me

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: and it's recognized as being something that totally transcends anything that we know

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: This transcendent force, the *Malchus* that creates everything, is hidden from our understanding. We really do not know what it is, or at least its nature.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Once one has grasped the manner in which the created *yesh* comes about, the mind recognizes that the transcendent source must be there.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Even a physicist today sees that the laws of nature, "the laws of creation" as the Rebbe liked to call them, can be understood up to a point: how gravity and electromagnetism work, and so how the planets and stars work.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Why it is so, what sets it in motion, we do not know. A deeper reality lies behind it, and it did not have to be this way, a choice, so to speak; but what that is lies beyond our knowledge.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: Books on the limits of knowledge
blocks.text: Great modern books treat the limits of human knowledge: what we know we cannot know, what we do not know whether we could know, what more study may solve. Past a certain line lies what is beyond anything in created existence.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: This G-dly source is grasped only in a very hidden way: a person is aware that there is something beyond him, and that is all.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: It is recognized as something that totally transcends anything we know.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

sections.summary: The same two sides apply to the details of *Atzilus*: its lights and vessels, the *chesed* and *chochma* that emanate, and the middos. Each can be grasped to a degree, but the essence of the emanator, which shines through them, is hidden and beyond all thought.

phrases.en: the lights and the vessels

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: for example

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: באצילות אור חסד שבמלכות או באצילות אור חסד שבחכמה
phrases.en: the emanation of the light of *chesed* of *Malchus* or the light of *chesed* of *chachma*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: So we can have some understanding of this idea of emanation, which is basically the idea of G-d's self-expression, how there's this expression of G-d's essence through these attributes

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: מאור הנאצל למטה בגילוי מהעלם העצמות
phrases.en: we can understand that through various metaphors like light, physical light, let's say, the light of the sun, or the way a person's soul is expressed, and things like that, from the essence that the hidden essence is being revealed and expressed in some way

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Likewise, just as the angels of *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya* show two sides, so in *yichuda ila'a*, studying the details of *Atzilus*, its lights and vessels: for example, how the light of *chesed* of *Malchus*, or of *chesed* of *chachma*, is emanated.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Emanation, G-d's self-expression, His hidden essence revealed through these attributes, can be understood through metaphors: physical light, like the sun's, or the way a person's soul is expressed, as discussed before and to be discussed again.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: כמו ויאצל מן הרוח דמשה כו'
phrases.en: like it says, that Moshe emanated and gave some of his spirit to the elders

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: And so, in a similar way,

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: ויושג גם כן בענין התהוות מדות דאצילות
phrases.en: and we can also understand something of how the *middos* of *Atzilus* are created

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: גם שהן בחינת מקוריים נבדלים מן השפעה האלהי״ת בנבראים כו'
phrases.en: even though that the *middos* of *Atzilus* are these spiritual forces and these spiritual sources which are totally, you know, transcend the physical, what the g-dly light is coming into creation

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: Moshe's spirit given to the elders
blocks.text: As it says, Moshe emanated of his spirit to the elders: he did not change, but he inspired them, and they came to express something of his character and wisdom.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: So G-d imbues these attributes, which are not G-d themselves, with the ability to become G-dly: a G-dly kindness and wisdom, expressing the infinite creative ability that is G-d's hallmark, unlike human *chesed* and *chachma*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: We can also understand something of how the *middos* of *Atzilus* come about, through these *meshalim*, though they are spiritual sources wholly beyond the G-dly light that comes into creation.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: אבל בחינת אין האמיתי המאיר עליהם מאור עצמות המאצילם,
phrases.en: but the true G-dly *ayin*, the true G-d's true essence that is shining through and being expressed through those different attributes, the light of the essence of the emanator

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: that can't be understood even with this kind of comparison and metaphor

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: it's just something that we can recognize in this very hidden way that we know it's true

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: והוא בבחינת ראית השכל שלמעלה מן השגה ותפיסא ממש
phrases.en: and this is just that the mind sees it, and really this is like the soul seeing it, it's like *emuna*, that we can recognize, but it's in a way that's beyond true understanding and true grasp

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: וכמאמר לית מחשבה תפיסא בך כו',
phrases.en: like it says, that no thought can grasp You

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: and this refers to the *machshava* of *bina*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: because seeing with *chachma* is really the opposite of understanding

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: כי כל שמעמיק יותר, יותר מופלא הימנו עצמיות אור המאציל
phrases.en: because the deeper appreciation you have for this, what G-dliness really is, for the essence of the light of the emanator

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: what it means that G-d is really a G-d, and He's all-powerful and all these things, the more that you appreciate that, the more you recognize how it transcends any of our known limits, anything within time, anything within space, anything physical, even anything spiritual, and it just transcends

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: and the sign that a person does have this recognition of this G-dly essence is that

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: they have this deep sense of humility and awe and wonder, as opposed to this sense of feeling like, oh, I've got it in my back pocket in the sense of mastery

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: But the true *ayin*, G-d's essence shining through the attributes, is the light of the essence of the emanator. Creating something from nothing expresses *chesed* of *Atzilus*, a G-dly *chesed*: a person can give something, but not existence.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Yet *chesed* of *Atzilus* is only an example of G-d's essential, infinite ability, beyond even comparison. His kindness can be compared to ours, so the attributes can be grasped; the essence behind them cannot be compared at all.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: It is known only in a hidden way: through *emuna* the soul senses deeply that G-d is unlimited and can do anything, though we cannot explain it from experience. The mind sees it, really the soul, beyond true understanding and grasp.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: As it says, no thought can grasp You. The inner G-dly side of the whole chain of worlds is beyond human experience; all our metaphors miss the true *nimshal*, an aspect we cannot know at all.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: This refers to the *machshava* of *bina*. The *machshava* of *bina* cannot grasp this side of the equation.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The seeing of *chachma* is the opposite of understanding, which builds a system and a logic. Scientists who really know what they are talking about, and mathematicians, recognize today that any logical theory is only an effective theory, useful for some aspects of reality, never all of it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: So any framework or model of *bina* cannot grasp the true essence even of physical reality, still less the transcendent reality of *chachma*, the sense of an unlimited, creative possibility to do anything.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: Learning to draw
blocks.text: Give someone who has learned to draw paper and pencils and ask for a work of art: he senses he could make anything, an unlimited ability he cannot explain to anyone. What he draws will be one particular drawing; the sense that he could do anything is inherently transcendent.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: With G-dliness even more so. We appreciate some of creation's wisdom, but seeing it as an example of His infinite ability means seeing an ability beyond all we know, and so beyond *bina*, which builds on comparisons with what we know.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: So the seeing of *chachma* is the opposite of the understanding of *bina*. The deeper one appreciates what G-dliness is, that G-d is all-powerful, the more it transcends every limit we know, time, space, the physical, even the spiritual, and the less anything can frame it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Its sign is a deep *bittul*, humility, awe and wonder, the opposite of feeling you have it in your back pocket. So the two must be balanced.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: Newton and the seashore
blocks.text: Isaac Newton, Rabbi Walters believes, said he felt like a child at the seashore of infinite knowledge, holding a tiny drop. A healthy exploration of G-d's creation always brings this sense: I know so much, yet the more I know, the vaster what I do not know.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: That is the sign that a person has the *chachma* side of the equation in his radar and in his awareness.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

sections.title: Bittul and joy come together in every detail, in proportion to understanding
sections.summary: The two feelings from *chachma* and *bina* must come together in every detail a person studies, and they are proportional: the more he really understands, the more *bittul* he has. Imagined *bittul*, without understanding, is a vain fantasy.

phrases.he: ונמצא בחינת הביטול והשמחה שמסתעפים ונולדים מחכמה ובינה שבכל פרט,
phrases.en: So, therefore, it comes out that these two like emotional effects, these two feelings of both having the sense of humility and awe and wonder, and the joy and sense of satisfaction of mastery, that these which come from the *chachma* and *bina* type of perception

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: those should come together with every single detail that a person is studying

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: בכל התבוננות בכל פרט ופרט דווקא

phrases.en: and actually these two are interdependent

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: ואם לא השמחה ביש מההשגה בטוב,
phrases.en: if a person doesn't have this joy, and this sense of accomplishment from really learning and knowing and mastering what you can know of G-d's creation

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: לא יבוא להפלאת וריחוק ההשגה באי''ן
phrases.en: then they're not really truly able to say that they appreciate the wonder, and have a real *bittul* and real *emuna* to G-d, and recognize how He transcends it

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: ולפי ערך השמחה כך ערך הביטול ממש,
phrases.en: And according to that *simcha*, that joy and that sense of accomplishment, exactly proportional to that, is going to be a person's *bittul*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: כי כפי ערך ההשגה במתהווה, כך ערך ההפלאה בהבדל המהווה כו'
phrases.en: because according to how much a person understands the greatness of what G-d has created, that's going to give the person that sense of wonder and humility and *bittul* to the transcendence of the Creator and the force that's creating it

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: So the two feelings, the *bittul* of humility, awe and wonder that *chachma* gives and the *simcha* of mastery that *bina* gives, must come together in every single detail a person studies.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Appreciating any aspect of creation, any level of the chain of worlds, a person should gain real understanding and mastery: something he can know, explain and point to. *Chachma* alone, an indescribable spiritual experience, is not grounded and teaches him nothing. And he needs the wonder and *bittul* of knowing his limits, both together in every detail.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The two are interdependent: seeming opposites, each feeds the other, and either one done properly comes with the other equally.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: A person who lacks the joy of accomplishment from really learning what he can know of G-d's creation cannot truly say that he appreciates the wonder, has real *bittul* and *emuna*, or recognizes how G-d transcends it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: He fools himself who claims *bittul* and *emuna* but never stops to examine G-d's works and cannot point to their wonder: then that feeling is not true either. This is why we learn and do *hisbonenus*, so that the *chachma* perception is real and the *emuna* internal and personal.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: According to the *simcha*, so is the *bittul*. The more a person understands the greatness of what G-d created, the more wonder and humility he has before the transcendence of the Creator and the force that creates it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: So in any field: whoever really studies a discipline stands in awe of its masters, great musicians, artists or scientists, and that is only between humans.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: That awe needs intimate understanding of what they did. Appreciating the *Rebbe*, the *Rambam*, *Moshe Rabbeinu* or any *tzaddik* comes from studying their works, teachings and way of life; the more one knows, the greater they must be, beyond imagining.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: Thinking he is just a regular person

sensitivity.reason: Contempt for people who do not know or study the tzaddikim: "People with that ignorance", and their ignorant view of them.
sensitivity.publishable: Someone who knows nothing about them, and does not study them, thinks, "They're just a regular Joe Schmo like me." People without that knowledge often feel, "What's the big deal? They're some holy dude, basically like me." It takes intimate knowledge to create a sense of proportion and wonder, to recognize that this comes from someone beyond the regular person, and to realize in the end that he is incomparably beyond me.
sensitivity.judgmentNote: The mockery of the ignorant view is his. The flagged words are the contempt in "ignorance"; the point (intimate knowledge gives proportion) stands in both texts. A person decides whether the contempt prints.

blocks.text: Someone who knows nothing about them, and does not study them, thinks, "They're just a regular Joe Schmo like me." People with that ignorance often feel, "What's the big deal? They're some holy dude, basically like me." It takes intimate knowledge to create a sense of proportion and wonder, to recognize that this comes from someone beyond the regular person, and to realize in the end that he is incomparably beyond me.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: That is between created beings: the *Rebbe* would often say a small child and a great scientist differ only in degree, since the child can grow into that. Before the Creator the awe and *bittul* are greater still.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: We throw the word G-d around, but without study we do not know whom we are talking about, nor have proper reverence, *bittul* and awe without appreciating the vastness of His works.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: וזהו כלל גדול בכל ההתבוננות בפרט
phrases.en: and this is a great general principle, general rule that we need to bear in mind when we're studying any detail

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: whether they're focusing on every detail or on the general, big picture

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: (מה שאין כן מי שנדמה לא שתופס היטב ההתהוות
phrases.en: On the other hand, if a person just imagines that he's grasped very well and very clearly, he's really mastered the creation

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: ואין לו בחינת ביטול מצד המהווה, לא השיג כלום בוודאי בלי ספק
phrases.en: and he doesn't have this humility and subservience and sense of awe and wonder to the Creator, he surely didn't understand anything without a doubt

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: ומי שידמה לו בחינת הביטול בעצמו מצד הפלאת ערך המהווה כו'
phrases.en: and when you have the opposite, sometimes a person could imagine that they have this great *bittul* and great *emuna* in G-d

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: ולא השיג בכי טוב לאופן המתהוה כו',
phrases.en: but they didn't properly understand and grasp the greatness of the creation, and how it's created, and how that relates to the Creator

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: דמיון שווא הוא ואין לו בחינת ביטול כלל
phrases.en: And so, it's just a vain imagination, it's just a fantasy, and they really have no *bittul* at all

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: because the two are totally interdependent

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: and they're completely proportional

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

phrases.en: for this reason we've explained

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: This is a great principle for studying any detail, whether a chapter of *Shaar HaYichud*, a *hisbonenus*, a *sichah*, a *maamar*, or the *Zohar* and the *Arizal*: always within this framework.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Detailed or general (chapter 4), both sides must be balanced: understanding that is real, something you can point to and master, with the awareness that it comes from something transcendent, so you do not grow arrogant and think you have mastered it. Seeing both brings true *bittul*, humility and awe.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The parenthesis is about lacking the balance. Whoever imagines he has grasped creation very well but lacks *bittul* before the Creator surely understood nothing, without a doubt.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: One can learn *Chassidus* and *Kabbalah* and feel a master for all the words and levels he can talk about; if it brought him no *bittul*, no wonder or humility before the source, he does not understand what is going on at all.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Others are interested in feeding their ego, or they come to it without proper training. They gain enough knowledge and enough words to sound intelligent and feel like an authority, but they do not have true understanding. So they do not have the proper respect and awe for what they are talking about, because they lack the perspective of what all this really means.

sensitivity.reason: Attributes to a group of people ("Others") a motive, feeding their ego, and calls them intelligent-sounding but without true understanding.
sensitivity.publishable: Some come to it without proper training. They gain enough knowledge and enough words to sound intelligent and feel like an authority, but they do not have true understanding. So they do not have the proper respect and awe for what they are talking about, because they lack the perspective of what all this really means.
sensitivity.judgmentNote: The description of learners without understanding is his point and stays. The flagged words are the ego motive attributed to "Others". A person decides whether the sneer at their authority prints.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: It is important to recognize that someone who claims to be a big expert, and says a lot of words, but does not have that *bittul*, shows that he is misguided and is not really studying it properly. He does not really understand it.

sensitivity.reason: Contempt for a type of person who claims to be an expert in Chassidus ("a big expert", "misguided").
sensitivity.publishable: It is important to recognize that someone who says a lot of words, but does not have that *bittul*, shows that he is not really studying it properly. He does not really understand it.
sensitivity.judgmentNote: The point, that words without bittul show weak study, is his and stays. The flagged words are the claim to be an expert and "misguided". A person decides whether they print.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Or one imagines he has great *bittul* and *emuna*. The soul's natural *emuna* is a gift, though even it generally needs some *hisbonenus* to wake it; but real inner *bittul*, in the mind and heart, comes only from real understanding.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Without properly grasping the greatness of creation and how it relates to the Creator, he cannot explain his *bittul*. Some learn *Chassidus* and it turns on the soul's external *emuna*: they feel uplifted, sure of their great *bittul*, without really understanding it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: They talk of *Atzilus* and *Adam Kadmon*, uplifted just by the abstraction: the spiritual sickness that the Alter Rebbe's *maamar*, mentioned in the previous chapter, describes, excitement over abstract ideas not grounded in true understanding.

blocks.title: A study partner's question
blocks.text: Then ask: what is *Atzilus* at the table? A very grounded study partner of his would ask of everything they learned, "Why should I care?" Frustrating at times, but it is the question to ask ourselves.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: How do I see this in the world around me, why should I care? Without grasping it tangibly there, his *bittul* is not true either.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: It is a vain imagination and a fantasy, and such people have no real *bittul* at all. It is really a veiled arrogance, making them think that they are spiritual and close to G-d, because they want to be, and they feel it is a noble thing. So they try to imitate it, like little kids imitate adults. But it is not a real thing.

sensitivity.reason: Contempt for people who study Chassidus and claim spiritual attainment: "veiled arrogance", imitating "like little kids".

blocks.text: The two are interdependent. In any field, a doctor must really study the body, and whoever builds technology or a bridge had better know his engineering; he cannot just feel one with the universal laws of nature. Connection to G-d likewise requires real study of these topics, and the *bittul* is proportional to the understanding, for the reason explained.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: There is a *makif* *bittul* that comes from action, training and environment, and it has its advantages; but the inner *bittul*, the *avodah* within mind and heart, requires understanding. There is no way around that.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: A spark of G-dly inspiration from above is *makif*; feelings internalized in the mind and heart come only through real understanding and study. There is no way around it.

blocks.text: As all who have tasted true *hisbonenus* know, the proof is in the pudding: once you taste the real thing you cannot go back, and you do not fool yourself at all.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Those raised in the ways of *Chassidus* know it too: they were guided not to fool themselves, and to tell a *makif* *emuna* and upbringing from real inner understanding and feeling.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: But many people, perhaps most, fool themselves in all this, in many different ways. In general there is a big lack of guidance: no one really teaches this, though some study such books.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: One of the earliest books written on this, *Chovos HaLevavos* (*Duties of the Heart*), laments that people neglect the inner aspects of religion. One can say he believes in G-d because he was trained to, but the words mean nothing unless he understands what he believes in.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: What does it mean that G-d is one? Everyone believes in monotheism, but without studying G-d's unity one does not know what he is saying or believing.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 05/Shaar HaYichud 047 ch 5 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: So too love and fear of G-d and the other inner feelings, born only from really studying what we believe and the greatness of G-d's creation. This is the real *avodah pnimis*, fundamental in Judaism, stressed in *Chassidus*, and especially in *Chassidus Chabad*.

notes.text: Class 047 line 28 is read "of Malchus of Atzilus" where the chapter line reads Asiya. The teacher's words are kept as said; the reviewer may want to check the tape.

Class 047 w4027: the transcript gives an unclear word in its place ("the [unclear] liked to call the laws of creation"). Unclear who is meant, so the name is left out and the block says only "the laws of nature".

The Tanya aside on the impurity of secular wisdom is flagged other-groups (judgment). Tanya's impurity is quoted as he gives it. The flagged link to secular wisdom is replaced in the publishable text ("that can come with learning"). His gloss, which he marks as his own ("I think"), is written "Rabbi Walters thinks" in both texts, so that it stays his opinion.

Criticism of people is flagged where it is contempt for an unnamed group: "Others are interested in feeding their ego" (the block after the Chassidus and Kabbalah passage), "a big expert ... misguided", "People with that ignorance" (the aside on the tzaddikim, line 41 or 42), and "veiled arrogance" with "like little kids" (the block on people who imitate it, line 46). Not flagged: his description of people who learn Chassidus and feel bittul without understanding it, and "a lot of people ... fool themselves" (line 48), which describe a state rather than insult. A reviewer may decide otherwise.

The study-partner recollection ("Why should I care?") is the teacher's own, with no name and no circumstances beyond the trait of being earthy and grounded. Not flagged private; a reviewer may decide.

Hedges kept: "Rabbi Walters thinks" (the Tanya gloss on line 6, and bittul as mainly awe on line 15), "But I think the bigger idea" (conservation of energy, line 27), "I believe" (the Newton quote, line 38), "I guess the majority of people" (line 48). Dropped: "I don't know" and similar tics.

Hebrew-only phrases (he reads them with no English of his of their own; where he gives English, it is in the block): line 2 (a clause he reads without rendering); the closing 'etc.' of lines 4, 8, 12, 15 and 16; the clause on line 32 that is read and glossed by the block only; the clause on line 39 ('as explained above'); the phrase on line 41 ('every single detail'), whose English comes in the phrase before it; the clause on line 47 ('for the reason'), followed by 'for this reason we've explained'; and the closing 'etc.' of line 48 and of line 49.
Line 16 ends in a Hebrew clause ("and he does not even feel this") that he renders a sentence later ("He's not even aware that he was moved", 046 w2970-2977); that phrase cites the later sentence.

Line 22 has a Hebrew clause on the wonder of the hidden source that he renders after the line ("they have this total recognition of the transcendence ...", 047 w515-536); that phrase cites the later sentence.

"The Rebbe" (the aside on a tzaddik's place in a list, and the comparison of a small child with a great professor): the transcript's word for Rabbi or Rebbe may mean Rabbi (Yehuda HaNasi) or the Rebbe (Schneerson). Written as "the Rebbe"; a person should check the audio before the text is published.
